assumption: For a pseudo-target T, each source may contribute only values dated at or before T-1. Source-specific observed coverage asymmetry is retained; an observed max year is not treated as a proven publication date.
selection_reason: Closest simple historical replay that preserves the observed source freshness asymmetry.

assumption: For a pseudo-target T, every source is held back through T-2. This is a one-year more conservative freshness stress than P1, while source-specific coverage, missingness, benchmark domains, and quality boundaries remain unchanged.
selection_reason: Sensitivity comparison for an additional publication/availability lag; not a claim about the real calendar.
